name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (LPG)
description: Provides deposit-free LPG connections to women from below-poverty-line households.
eligibility: Women (18+) from BPL households as per SECC criteria.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection; cheaper cooking fuel; health benefits.
steps: Visit pmuy.gov.in or nearest LPG distributor.
ai_summary: PM Ujjwala Yojana gives BPL women deposit-free LPG connections for clean cooking fuel.

name: NGDRBharat (Digitized Land Records)
description: National Generic Document Registration System providing unified digital land/property registration across states.
eligibility: State residents using integrated land registration offices.
benefits: Transparent, faster property registration; digital records; reduced fraud.
steps: Fill deed details and upload documents.
Pay stamp duty; book appointment; sign digitally.
ai_summary: NGDRBharat is the national digital land/property registration platform enabling transparent deed registration.

name: India Post Services
description: Postal, parcel, Speed Post, savings accounts, POSB, IPPB banking, and government agency services.
eligibility: Open to all citizens; accounts per India Post schemes.
benefits: Nationwide postal + financial inclusion; IPPB digital banking; agency services.
steps: Visit nearest post office or indiapost.gov.in.
Open account / avail service with KYC.
Use IPPB app for digital banking.
ai_summary: India Post offers postal, parcel, and financial services including IPPB digital banking and savings accounts.

name: National Apprenticeship (Apprenticeship India)
description: National Apprenticeship Training scheme connecting apprentices with establishments for paid on-the-job training.
eligibility: ITI/diploma/degree holders (aged 14+ for certain categories) per Apprentices Act.
benefits: Stipend during training; industry experience; certification; employment pathway.
steps: Sign contract; undergo training with stipend.
ai_summary: Apprenticeship India links candidates to paid on-the-job training with certified establishments.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
description: Flagship skill-certification scheme offering free short-term training and certification to youth.
eligibility: Indian youth (often 15-45) seeking skill certification.
benefits: Free training, certification, placement support, monetary reward on certification.
steps: Complete training; appear for assessment; get certificate.
ai_summary: PMKVY provides free skill training and certification with placement support to Indian youth.

name: NIELIT Certification & Services
description: NIELIT provides electronics/IT training, certifications (O/A/B/C level), and digital literacy courses.
eligibility: Candidates per course (schooling/diploma as applicable).
benefits: Govt-recognized IT/electronics certifications; employment readiness.
steps: Complete training and examination; get certificate.
ai_summary: NIELIT offers government-recognized electronics and IT certifications and digital literacy courses.

name: Ayushman Bharat Health & Wellness Centres
description: Network of Health & Wellness Centres delivering comprehensive primary health care at the community level.
eligibility: All residents; ABHA-linked services; PM-JAY for eligible families.
benefits: Free essential health services, screenings, and referrals at HWCs.
ai_summary: Ayushman Bharat Health & Wellness Centres provide free primary health care at the community level.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Government accident insurance scheme with Rs. 2 lakh cover for death/disablement at premium Rs. 20/year.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18-70 with a linked bank account.
benefits: Low-cost accidental death/disablement cover; auto-debit enrolment.
steps: Give consent for auto-debit of Rs. 20.
ai_summary: PMSBY offers Rs. 2 lakh accident insurance cover at just Rs. 20/year for adults with a bank account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: National mission for financial inclusion providing zero-balance bank accounts with RuPay debit card and insurance.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen (resident) above 10 years; one account per person.
benefits: Zero-balance account, RuPay card, accident insurance, overdraft, DBT access.
steps: Visit bank/Bank Mitra with Aadhaar and proof.
ai_summary: PMJDY provides every household a zero-balance bank account with RuPay card and insurance cover.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Small-savings scheme for girl children (under 10 at opening) with attractive tax-free returns.
eligibility: Parents/guardians of a girl child below age 10; one account per child (max 2 per family).
benefits: High interest (govt-set), tax-free, partial withdrawal for education/marriage at 18+.
steps: Open at post office or authorised bank.
ai_summary: SSY is a government small-savings scheme for girl children with tax-free high returns.

name: Maha Anna (Maharashtra Ration / NFSA)
description: Maharashtra NFSA ration card and Public Distribution System for subsidised foodgrains.
eligibility: Maharashtra households meeting NFSA/state poverty criteria.
benefits: Subsidised rice/wheat/cereals via Fair Price Shops; portability under One Nation One Ration Card.
steps: Apply via MahaFood portal / rationing office.
ai_summary: Maha Anna is Maharashtra's NFSA ration system providing subsidised foodgrains through PDS.

name: Maharashtra Chief Minister Relief Fund
description: State relief fund assisting citizens in distress, natural calamities, and medical emergencies.
eligibility: Maharashtra residents in notified distress/calamity situations.
benefits: Financial assistance for calamity, medical, and ex-gratia support.
steps: Apply through district administration / online portal.
ai_summary: Maharashtra CM Relief Fund provides financial assistance to residents facing calamity or medical distress.

name: Maharashtra Farmer Welfare Schemes
description: State agriculture department schemes: farm loans, subsidies, crop insurance (PMFBY state window), and support.
eligibility: Maharashtra farmers with land records; scheme-specific criteria.
benefits: Input subsidies, loan waiver/relief, crop insurance, drip/solar subsidies.
steps: Select scheme; apply with land/identity docs.
ai_summary: Maharashtra farmer welfare schemes offer subsidies, crop insurance, and loan support via mahaagri.gov.in.

name: Delhi Ration Card / e-District
description: Delhi e-District portal for ration cards, certificates, and citizen services.
eligibility: Delhi residents as per service criteria.
benefits: Online certificates, ration card, and department services.
ai_summary: Delhi e-District provides online ration cards and certificates for Delhi residents.

name: Uttar Pradesh e-District / Ration
description: UP e-District portal for caste/income/residence certificates and ration services.
eligibility: Uttar Pradesh residents per service criteria.
benefits: Online certificates and scheme applications.
ai_summary: UP e-District delivers certificates and ration services online for Uttar Pradesh residents.

name: Digital Gujarat Portal
description: Gujarat's integrated portal for certificates, scholarships, and citizen services.
eligibility: Gujarat residents per service criteria.
benefits: Single-window certificates, scholarships, and schemes.
ai_summary: Digital Gujarat is the state single-window portal for certificates, scholarships, and services.

name: Karnataka Seva Sindhu / e-District
description: Karnataka's integrated service delivery portal for certificates and schemes.
eligibility: Karnataka residents per service criteria.
benefits: Online certificates, ration, and welfare schemes.
ai_summary: Seva Sindhu is Karnataka's single-window portal for citizen certificates and schemes.

name: Tamil Nadu e-Sevai / e-District
description: Tamil Nadu e-Sevai centres and portal for certificates and citizen services.
eligibility: Tamil Nadu residents per service criteria.
benefits: Online/offline certificates and service delivery.
ai_summary: Tamil Nadu e-Sevai provides certificates and citizen services through centres and portal.

name: West Bengal Duare Sarkar / e-District
description: West Bengal e-District / Duare Sarkar camps for certificates and schemes.
eligibility: West Bengal residents per service criteria.
benefits: Doorstep certificate and scheme enrolment camps.
steps: Attend Duare Sarkar camp or apply online.
ai_summary: West Bengal Duare Sarkar/e-District delivers certificates and schemes via camps and portal.

name: Rajasthan e-Mitra / SSO
description: Rajasthan SSO / e-Mitra single-sign-on for state services and certificates.
eligibility: Rajasthan residents; SSO ID registration.
benefits: Unified access to hundreds of state services via e-Mitra kiosks.
ai_summary: Rajasthan SSO/e-Mitra is the single-sign-on gateway to state citizen services.
